# Width (tablem)

This fixture forces the `cmarker + tablem` pipeline so we test that width hints
based on the number of `-` in the separator row are preserved.

## Proportional widths

| Key | Description | % |
|-|--------|-|
| ID1 | The Description column should be much wider than Key/% when rendered via tablem. | 100 |

## Mixed proportions

| A | B | C | D |
|-|--|------|-|
| 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
| left | mid | wide wide wide wide wide wide | right |
